d1m3-a1.title: Representation Notice — the email that stops direct contact
d1m3-a1.kicker: Keystone has already called him. From today, every contact comes to the firm.
d1m3-a1.subject: John Doe — collision of 02/06/2026 with your insured Robert Smith — represented by LSH Law Group
d1m3-a1.attachment: None: the formal Letter of Representation follows at claim set-up
d1m3-a1.brief: Write to the adjuster who called John Doe: the firm represents him, all contact comes to this office and never to him directly, any Recorded Statement request goes in writing to Atty. Thorne, and she should confirm. Fault, the crash and value are not yours to discuss.

required.label: Says LSH Law Group represents John Doe
required.hint: Open with who you represent: John Doe, by LSH Law Group, Atty. Thorne lead counsel.

required.label: Tells her not to contact John Doe directly; all contact to the firm
required.hint: Say plainly: no direct contact with Mr. Doe; every contact comes to this office.

required.label: Puts any Recorded Statement request in writing to Atty. Thorne
required.hint: Say he will not give a statement to her, and any request goes in writing to Atty. Thorne.

required.label: Asks her to confirm the file shows him represented
required.hint: Ask her to confirm by reply that Keystone's file now shows him represented by the firm.

reply.subject: RE: John Doe — collision of 02/06/2026 with your insured Robert Smith — represented by LSH Law Group
reply.body: Received. I have noted our file that Mr. Doe is represented by your office and that contact goes through you. For the record, I spoke with Mr. Doe briefly on 02/09/2026 to open the claim; no statement was taken. I will send the claim number to your office once it is assigned.

press.subject: RE: John Doe — Recorded Statement
press.body: Thanks. To move this along, could Mr. Doe give me a short Recorded Statement this week? It takes ten minutes and it helps us look at liability sooner. If you send me his cell number and a good time, I will set it up with him directly.

choices.label: Send her John's cell number and a time this week.
choices.why: You have just arranged the very contact you told her to stop, and whether John gives a statement to the adverse carrier is Atty. Thorne's decision.

choices.label: Reply that any statement request goes in writing to Atty. Thorne and contact stays with the firm; forward it today.
choices.why: Correct. Nothing is agreed and nothing is refused for John: the request is recorded, routed the same day, and the no-contact line holds.

choices.label: Reply that John declines because liability is clear from the Police Report.
choices.why: Declining for him and arguing fault are not yours. The request goes to Atty. Thorne, and liability is his to discuss.

lines: Recorded Statement request of 02/11/2026 answered: any request goes in writing to Atty. Thorne; contact stays with the firm.

CMS → Doc Hub → Others, named the firm's way.

establishes: Keystone knows, in its adjuster's own words, that John Doe is represented and that contact goes through the firm, from 02/10/2026.
No statement was taken on 02/09/2026, on the adjuster's own account.
The statement request was routed to Atty. Thorne in writing; the Case Manager decided nothing about it.
Nothing about fault, the crash or the value of the claim was said to the carrier.
